subject: gk
question:
Consider the following groups of elements: 

A: ¹²₆C and ¹⁴₆C

B: ⁴⁰₁₆S and ⁴⁰₁₇Cl

C: ¹⁶₈O and ¹⁸₈O

D: ¹⁴₆C and ¹⁴₇N

‘Which of the following identifications regarding the given groups is correct?

options.text:
Isotopes: A and D

Isobars: B and C

Isotopes: A and C

Isobars: B and D

Isotopes: A and B

Isobars: C and D

Isotopes: C and D

Isobars: A and B

solution:
The correct answer is __**Isotopes: A and B, Isobars: C and D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Isotopes** are variants of a particular chemical element which differ in neutron number, and consequently in nucleon number. All isotopes of a given element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons in each atom.
 
• **Isobars** are atoms (nuclides) of different chemical elements that have the same number of nucleons. That is, isobars have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.
 
• Group A: ^(12)_6C and ^(14)_6C are isotopes because they have the same atomic number (6) but different mass numbers (12 and 14).
 
• Group B: ^(40)₁₆S and ^(40)₁₇Cl are isobars because they have the same mass number (40) but different atomic numbers (16 and 17).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isotopes**

 
 
• Isotopes of an element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
 
• For example, ^(12)_6C and ^(14)_6C both have 6 protons but 6 and 8 neutrons respectively.
 
• Isotopes can be stable or unstable (radioactive). Radioactive isotopes decay over time and emit radiation.
 
 
 
• **Isobars**
 
 
• Isobars have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.
 
• For example, ^(40)₁₆S and ^(40)₁₇Cl both have a mass number of 40, but their atomic numbers are 16 and 17 respectively.
 
• Isobars are different elements with different chemical properties.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Isotopes**
 
 
• Radioactive isotopes are used in medical imaging and treatment, such as in PET scans and cancer radiotherapy.
 
• Stable isotopes are used in scientific research to trace chemical and biological processes.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Isobars**
 
 
• Isobars are used in nuclear reactors and nuclear weapons.
 
• They help in understanding nuclear reactions and stability.
